technique_name: Summarise the news article "How technology is helping communities fight Covid-19".
description: Throughout the Covid-19 pandemic, technology has helped communities around the world stay connected and combat the virus. From wearable devices that help to monitor and track the spread of Covid-19, to virtual communication tools to assist with contactless socializing, technology has become a critical component in the fight against the virus.
